_note: Department pages that publish tentative/planned course offerings by quarter. Discovered with Tavily /search on 2026-09-27 and verified by hand. The nightly refresh (scripts/refresh-offerings.ts) re-discovers each page with /search, fetches the source (the published Google-Sheet CSV behind the CSE and COGS pages and the MATH HTML directly; ECE's table with /extract), skips unchanged content by sha256, and writes offerings/<DEPT>.json with a quote, url and fetchedAt for every course-term status.
